input: Listening and reading at the official time limits, in proportion.

challenge: Today’s challenge: after a full mock using a set of TV5MONDE Apprendre B1 listening and reading exercises, build your first “error map”: sort each wrong answer into main idea / detail / negation / opinion / grammar / vocabulary and count them; write down, in your own language, the 2 most frequent types and one concrete rule to fix them next week.
